execution_route: The shared core.flight.cli FIT path under this cell's own native_contact_fit ids; it measures request envelopes and produces no generation.
one_factor: None. This cell changes NO factor: it is the registered AGREE treatment, byte-for-byte in every knob, flown on a smaller roster. The only differences from SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-AGREE-W1-FOLD-A-V1 are the population (70 derived ids instead of 1,080) and the ceilings rescaled to it.

prepared_phase_supply.note: NONE COMMITTED, by design. The agreement merge moved the implementation sha256 of rails.kb_policy, rails.knowledge_provider and rails.phase_supply, which FlightRuntime._phase_seed_inputs binds, so every prepared_phase_supply pin in the repository is invalidated and any cell awaiting a flip must be re-pinned. This cell carries no pin at all: the flip mints its own under its own run id (item E16) and --allow-output-change must never be passed.

purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-CONV-FOLD-A-70-V1: cell CONV. It measures request envelopes only and reads nothing.
quality_read_gate: No read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist for this cell, and before the flown delivery check agrees with the offline derivation on all 70 rows. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
